title: isvarasiddhi — isva-p07-v56
question: One's own self indeed — this — flashes forth: Īśvara within all breathers, maker and knower too; yet recognition of the beyond is to be effected, and the joining is made by us elsewhere. But Īśvara-proved stands even in duality — fitting, and more: fire shines at midnight.
